title: Carlyle CEO on US Economy, Fed, MIT AI Partnership
description:
Carlyle CEO Harvey Schwartz sees the US economy “doing quite well,” despite uncertainty and inflation, and says the US is at a period where the Federal Reserve will continue to watch the data. Schwartz also discusses the firm’s partnership with MIT and his view on growth concerns related to artificial intelligence. Schwartz speaks with Dani Burger from the Carlyle 2026 Global Investor Conference.
